hypothesis.statement: A partial model download or implicit dependency can make a CUDA worker appear reproducible while changing geometry or violating production license constraints.
hypothesis.action: Pin code and minimal shape-only snapshots, require pre-masked RGBA inputs and DINOv3 approval evidence, forbid RMBG/Hunyuan, and keep every download behind explicit network opt-in.
hypothesis.expectedResult: A fresh worker can be bootstrapped deterministically without pulling unrelated texture models or prohibited dependencies.

decision: Keep the offline package. Execute downloads only on a verified Linux/CUDA worker after a named reviewer records DINOv3 license acceptance.
